title: Closing down the first base and transfer to the second base

tellings.quote: That base is actually I I close that base down. um the base itself closed, the entire base, not just our aspect of it.

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says he was hired by the NSA (the US National Security Agency, which handles electronic spying and codes) to communicate with aliens, says he was the one who closed down the first base where his secret program ran, sometime between 1990 and 1993, before moving to a second base. He tells Michels the whole base shut down, "not just our aspect of it." Sherman tells it as his own experience, as one step in how the program he describes moved from place to place.
